info.name: List all the SAAS environments on Service Manager Proxy.

params.name: serviceEnvironmentId
params.description:
The unique identifier associated with the service environment. 

**Note:** Not an [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

params.name: serviceEnvironmentType
params.description:
The environment's service definition type. 
For example, "RGBUOROMS" is the service definition type for "Oracle Retail Order Management Cloud Service".

params.name: limit
params.description: How many records to return. Specify a value greater than zero and less than or equal to 1000. The default is 30.

params.name: page
params.description: The value of the `opc-next-page` response header from the previous "List" call.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. ID is default ordered as ascending.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either `ASC` or `DESC`.

params.name: displayName
params.description: The display name of the resource.

items.docs:
List the details of Software as a Service (SaaS) environments provisioned by Service Manager.
Information includes the service instance endpoints and service definition details.

info.name: Gets details about the service environment.

params.name: serviceEnvironmentId
params.description:
The unique identifier associated with the service environment. 

**Note:** Not an [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm).

items.docs: Get the detailed information for a specific service environment.
